title: some colors bleed, badly!
text: some colors bleed, badly!. the  black and brown colors run!!!  i washed them 4 times.....with color catchers, then Retayne.......still the colors bleed!  this would be a 5-star product if it was not for the unstable dyes used.  i finally threw the black and brown napkins away.......just using the other colors, which have been OK.  High recommend pre-washing these and check for bleeding colors.
